author: Action_
body:
On maps like Justice III and Quintus, people with diamond can easily spawnkill. They can literally win a 6v1 right in spawn because the resistance is only 5 seconds. On maps like Justice III with a pathway from spawn, you need to have resistance at least until you can get outside of spawn. It sucks the fun out of the match when you aren't even able to leave your own spawn. I'm not asking for a ridiculous amount of resistance, just enough so you can at least repel the spawnkillers. This would be a great addition to some (if not all) of the maps.

Thanks!
